# Shortest Substring Covering All Characters of a Pattern

<!-- meta:begin -->

> **▶ [Solve it on TrueInterview](https://trueinterview.io/questions/minimum-window-substring-4)** — free, no card: a runnable editor, the sample and hidden tests, a judged verdict, and the reference solution.

## Problem

You are given two strings: a source string and a pattern string. Your task is to locate the shortest contiguous substring of the source in which every character of the pattern appears.

Repeated characters count: if a character occurs several times in the pattern, the chosen substring must include that character at least as many times as the pattern does.

If no substring of the source satisfies this requirement, return the empty string.

## Examples

**Example 1**

```text
Input: {"s": "ADOBECODEBANC", "t": "ABC"}
Output: "BANC"
```

**Example 2**

```text
Input: {"s": "a", "t": "a"}
Output: "a"
```

## Hints

<details>
<summary>Hint 1</summary>

Think of a window that expands until it covers the pattern and then shrinks as far as it can while staying valid.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Hint 2</summary>

Use a sliding window with two pointers and a frequency map of needed characters, plus a counter of how many requirements are currently satisfied.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Hint 3</summary>

Handle duplicate characters in the pattern by counting multiplicities, return the empty string when no window works, and target O(n + m) time.

</details>
